metadata.title: 101 Drinks and How to Mix Them
metadata.source_file: 1910 ca 101 Drinks and How to Mix them.txt
metadata.notes: Folleto estadounidense circa 1910 con un centenar de recetas de cocteles clasicos de la edad de oro previa a la Ley Seca. Incluye versiones canonicas de Manhattan, Martini, Old Fashioned, Sazerac, Side Car, Whiskey Sour, Gin Fizz, Stinger, Pink Lady, Knickerbocker, Bronx, Daiquiri, Sherry Cobbler, Mint Julep y Tom and Jerry, junto con preparaciones menos conocidas (Cape Cod Rainbow, Charlie Horse, Chattanooga Dew, Cherry Blossom, Hell-Raiser, Hiawatha, Snag-Tooth Nell, Pom Pom, Top Side Up). El OCR contiene erratas tipograficas habituales (DAQUIRI por Daiquiri, SAZARAC por Sazerac, SHALUTA por Saluta, SHANDYGAFF por Shandy Gaff). Saltadas (no son recetas reales): WORDS (Fragmento OCR del titulo 'FOREWORDS'); Simple: (Linea fragmentada (encabezado de variante 'Simple')); Maraschino Menthe (Linea fragmentada (Maraschino y crema de menta como ingredientes de un Pousse-Cafe)); Bourbon Whiskey Dash of Benedictine (Linea fragmentada (bourbon con un dash de Benedictine))

recipes.method_original: Dissolve sugar in a wine glass of boiling water; pour into silver-plated mug. Fill another wine glass with Scotch Whiskey. Ignite the whiskey and, while it is blazing, mix it with the syrup by pouring back and forth four or five times from one mug into the other. The effect will be one of liquid fire, both to the eye and to the palate.
